howToApply: Visit the LPSC online recruitment portal available from 1400 hrs on 29.09.2026 to 1400 hrs on 13.10.2026.
Register online and fill in the application form with complete and correct information.
Upload a recent passport-size photograph in JPG/JPEG format (max 40 KB, 95–100 pixels height and width).
Upload certificates/mark sheets pertaining to the prescribed essential qualifications.
Candidates belonging to fee-exempted categories (SC/ST/Disability/Ex-Servicemen) must upload applicable certificates for fee refund.
Pay the application fee of ₹750/- online immediately after submitting the application or latest by 1400 hrs on 14.10.2026 using the ‘Make Payment’ option on the portal.
Note down the online registration number for future reference.
No documents (printouts, certificates, payment receipts, etc.) need to be sent to LPSC after successful online registration.
Candidates intending to apply for more than one post must submit separate applications for each post.

howToApply: Visit the official recruitment portal: www.hckrecruitment.keralacourts.in
Complete ‘One Time Registration’ using the ‘One Time Registration Login’ link on the website.
After entering required details in ‘My Profile’, apply for the post from ‘Apply Now’ in ‘Dashboard’.
Fill in all required details and upload scanned images of photograph and signature.
Check the preview of the application before submission. Once submitted, no changes can be made.
Pay the application fee (if applicable) online via Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking/UPI or offline via system-generated Fee Payment Challan.
Take a printout of the application and keep it for future reference.
Candidates applying from abroad must forward an email with their location and public IP address to recruitment.hckerala@nic.in before applying.
